RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.en: Oh, no. Did Anna put you up to this? She keeps trying to convince me that chocolate can be eaten for breakfast, lunch, and dinner...
RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.cz: Ale ne. Na to tě Anna navedla? Pořád se mě snaží přesvědčit, že čokoládu lze jíst k snídani, obědu i večeři...

RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.en: Come on, Kristoff! Look at how many different uses it has!
RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.cz: No tak, Kristoffe! Podívej se, kolik různých využití to má!

RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.en: Anna needs to try some more kinds of food herself.

RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.original_cz: Anna by sama měla ochutnat další druhy jídla.

RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.en: I've gotta admit, you've made quite a spread here.

RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.en: I'll share this with Anna... For every one of the next three meals. Who knows? I might like it!

RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.en: *sigh* Yeah, it does look pretty tasty.
Oh, she's always open to trying all the food at royal banquets. She's just never found anything she likes as much as chocolate.
RemySpecialDeliveries_Kristoff/Kristoff_.cz: Ach, ona je vždycky ochotná ochutnat všechno jídlo na královských banketech. Jen nikdy nenašla nic, co by jí chutnalo tolik jako čokoláda.
